verdict.rationale: docs.ollama.com serves a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document titled "Ollama API" at /openapi.yaml, and the docs llms.txt lists it under "OpenAPI Specs", so the spec is machine-discoverable. The probe 404s are on ollama.com conventional paths, a different host, and do not contradict this. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness, and the spec is not served at the conventional ollama.com/openapi.json paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: docs.ollama.com serves a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document titled "Ollama API" whose description reads "OpenAPI specification for the Ollama HTTP API"
